verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a public marketing pricing page with per-GPU hourly rates (e.g., B300 at $8.99/hr), plus REST, GraphQL, CLI and MCP interfaces for managing Pods, endpoints, templates and volumes. None of these sources documents an endpoint an agent can query for the GPU catalog with live pricing and availability before spending. A static web pricing page and resource-management APIs are adjacent features, not the queried capability.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can query the GPU catalog with live pricing and availability from a public or documented endpoint before committing any spend
